comment: One kit, funk pattern, no fill: kick on the one plus two pushes at the and of 2 and the e of 3, snare accent on 2 and 4 with ghosts either side, hats running sixteenths as a wash with the offbeats a hair ahead of the grid. The section levels handle the dynamics, so the grid is identical for 16 bars and nothing here is busier than the one.
